baseline.config_delta: Embedded CONFIG_PAHOLE_VERSION=132 vs historical supplied131; all otherlines identical per retained correspondence. Do not confuse original config with reproduced generated config.

pinned_scope.observation: 7.1/kernel-patches tree contains misc and scheduler patches; primary README says core changes are topic merges in CachyOS/linux. No moving master patch is applied.

upstream_lineage.metadata_warning: GitHub commit verification observed via API; no independent cryptographic owner trust verified.

candidates.reason: An empty per-CPU BIO cache falls directly to mempool fallback; a non-sleeping allocation returns NULL without trying slab. The eight-line hunk shares the existing slab attempt with the cache-miss path. Cache-hit path and allocation flags remain unchanged.
candidates.config: CONFIG_BLOCK=y; no new Kconfig symbol; CONFIG_NVME_APPLE=y inherits common block allocation.
candidates.interactions: Apple NVMe storage consumers may observe fewer avoidable allocation failures; full kernel/runtime behavior remains unverified. No Apple NVMe, DART, SART, RTKit, device tree, boot, AGX, MCA, AOP, speaker protection, cpufreq, thermal or PMGR code/config changes. Graphics/audio can be affected indirectly by storage and memory pressure; explicit native storage correctness and low-latency audio-under-I/O checks remain necessary.
candidates.page_size: No literal 4096, PAGE_SIZE, PAGE_SHIFT, page-table, DMA geometry or ABI change; 16K baseline is preserved. This source observation is not 16K execution evidence.
candidates.license: block/bio.c SPDX GPL-2.0 and existing Jens Axboe copyright; Linux COPYING GPL-2.0-only WITH Linux-syscall-note; original patch author Joseph Qi, Suggested-by/Reviewed-by Christoph Hellwig retained.

candidates.decision: NOT SELECTED: finite secondary correctness candidate
candidates.reason: Nineteen added lines truncate converted descriptor strings at C0/DEL, preserving bytes >=0x80; generic usb_string affects product/manufacturer/serial consumers. Baseline has no truncation loop. Broader external-device naming/identity semantics than selected BIO hunk.
candidates.interactions: Touches common USB device identity before HID/userspace seats; could change peripheral serial IDs, cached strings and matching. Apple controller drivers unchanged, but external USB audio, keyboards, docks and reconnect/resume behavior would need tests. No 4K/page-size literal.
candidates.license: SPDX GPL-2.0, file explicitly states GPLv2 only; Taylor Hewetson author/signoff retained.

candidates.reason: Forty-nine-line change replaces folio+offset scatterlist with tail-page array and sg_alloc_table_from_pages. Larger DMA/mapping change; CONFIG_UDMABUF is not set, so enabling the feature would add a second variable.
candidates.config: CONFIG_DMA_SHARED_BUFFER=y but CONFIG_UDMABUF is not set.
candidates.interactions: No direct Asahi AGX patch, but shared DMA-buffer mappings, contiguous segments, PAGE_SHIFT and IOMMU interactions merit physical16K/DART/graphics validation if ever enabled. Never substitute PAGE_SIZE=4096.
candidates.license: SPDX GPL-2.0; Jason Gunthorpe author/signoff and reported issue link retained.

candidates.reason: Ninety-two-line shared reclaim/writeback-statistic/throttling change affects MGLRU and non-MGLRU; CONFIG_LRU_GEN is not set does not prove patch inactive. Upstream reproducer needs loop/dm-delay mounted filesystem and broad reclaim stress, exceeding bounded source-only experiment.
candidates.config: CONFIG_LRU_GEN is not set; CONFIG_TRANSPARENT_HUGEPAGE is not set. Preserve both.
candidates.interactions: Global reclaim/dirty writeback can affect AGX allocation, audio underruns, Apple NVMe pressure and thermal/power behavior. No architecture-specific diff, but 16K allocation stress and suspend/resume are unresolved.
candidates.license: SPDX GPL-2.0; existing Linus Torvalds copyright and source notices retained.

candidates.reason: Default HZ1000/full preempt overlaps retained Asahi CONFIG_HZ1000/CONFIG_PREEMPT=y; it is not a new measured gain. Cachy THP=always, O3, ThinLTO, full tickless, scheduler/config and native x86 CPU selections are not approved substitutions. THP is disabled in retained16K config.
candidates.config: Keep ARM64_16K_PAGES=y, ARCH_APPLE=y, HZ1000, PREEMPT=y, schedutil default, THP off and Asahi driver selections exact.
candidates.interactions: Changing ticks/preemption/THP/compiler affects audio latency, graphics memory/reclaim, boot and battery/thermal behavior. Recipe is arch x86_64 and enables X86_NATIVE_CPU by default; never run it as an ARM recipe or infer generic means ARM.
candidates.license: Recipe declares GPL-2.0-only but repository LICENSE.md is GPLv3; no recipe code/config copied or executed. This audit does not resolve repository-wide packaging-license ambiguity.
